Execute a sequence of multiple actions (click, type, click) and verify all succeed with correct indices

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'browser' => { 'mode' => 'always' } }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.interact(engine, url, [{ 'selector' => '#open', 'type' => 'click' }, { 'selector' => '#field', 'text' => 'test_data', 'type' => 'type' }, { 'selector' => '#submit', 'type' => 'click' }])
puts result.inspect
```
